title: 小学一年级
description: 适合6-7岁有一定英语基础的孩子，开始接触自然拼读、简单对话和跨学科词汇
descriptionEn: For children aged 6-7 with some English foundation. Starting phonics, simple conversations, and cross-subject vocabulary.

items.description: 26个字母化身小人拼出单词，自然拼读规则可视化，学拼读必看。
items.descriptionEn: 26 letters turn into little people spelling words. Phonics rules visualized, a must-see for learning phonics.

items.description: 字母积木姊妹篇，数字叠加分解演示加减法，数学+英语双启蒙。
items.descriptionEn: Alphablocks sister series. Numbers combine and decompose to demonstrate addition and subtraction. Math and English dual enlightenment.

items.description: 牛津专家开发的教学向动画，词汇句式循环到极致，看完可掌握600+基础词。
items.descriptionEn: Teaching animation developed by Oxford experts. Vocabulary and sentence patterns repeat extensively. Master 600+ basic words after watching.

items.description: 三只圆润小恐龙的小探险，色彩明丽，单词句式反复出现，恐龙迷必入。
items.descriptionEn: Three round little dinosaurs' small adventures. Bright colors, repeated words and sentence patterns. A must for dinosaur fans.

items.description: 四名实习探险员环游世界，地理与文化知识融入冒险，指令类词汇多。
items.descriptionEn: Four trainee explorers travel the world. Geography and cultural knowledge integrated into adventures, lots of command vocabulary.

items.description: 改编自托尼·罗斯绘本，调皮小公主的成长日常，情绪管理与规则教育自然融入。
items.descriptionEn: Adapted from Tony Ross's picture books. The growing daily life of a naughty little princess, naturally integrating emotional management and rule education.

items.description: 澳洲牧牛犬一家的温馨日常，游戏里藏着育儿智慧，全球口碑神作。
items.descriptionEn: Warm daily life of an Australian cattle dog family. Parenting wisdom hidden in games, a global word-of-mouth masterpiece.

items.description: 哥哥查理和妹妹罗拉的日常拌嘴，画风童趣，长句多，适合有基础的孩子。
items.descriptionEn: Brother Charlie and sister Lola's daily bickering. Childlike style, many long sentences, suitable for kids with foundation.

items.description: 超市里会飞的超级土豆大战邪恶豌豆，节奏明快，孩子一看就上瘾。
items.descriptionEn: Flying Super Potato in the supermarket fights evil peas. Fast pace, kids get addicted at first sight.

items.description: 书店老板Dog和Pug掉进书里冒险，每集融入一个新故事，鼓励阅读。
items.descriptionEn: Bookstore owners Dog and Pug fall into books for adventures. Each episode integrates a new story, encouraging reading.

items.description: 小女孩兽医帮助动物朋友，动物身体与照料词汇丰富，温柔有爱。
items.descriptionEn: Little girl vet helps animal friends. Rich vocabulary on animal bodies and care, gentle and loving.

items.description: 真人主持人穿越恐龙时代与自然世界，科普词汇密集，孩子看得目不转睛。
items.descriptionEn: Live host travels through dinosaur age and natural world. Dense science vocabulary, children watch with fixed eyes.
